target: QEMU ARM64 graphical guest compile probe
scope: The pinned MakeHome source compiles with the stock TOS and system module context in an isolated ARM64 guest task. This is compile evidence only.
adaptations: The source bundle exposes the ARM64-adapted stock TOS files at the root-level paths used by MakeHome's ~/TOS include fallback.
The isolated compile context loads the stock Hash and God Bible modules and the kernel global declarations required by MakeHome's dependency tree.
limitation: MakeHome installation and runtime behavior are not verified by this compile probe.
